locator.section: Eq. 8.2, arrow 4.5, inductive (secondary: acylium -> CO + CH3+)

evidence.curator_note: adduct corrected to null (convention G): the species undergoing this reaction is an EVEN-ELECTRON cation (charge +1, radical_electrons 0) - a fragment/secondary-fragmentation precursor - NOT the [M]+. radical molecular ion. precursor_mz corrected to the m/z of the ion that actually undergoes the drawn reaction (convention G: the reacting species sets adduct + precursor_mz); it previously carried the neutral molecule's molecular-ion m/z, which describes the parent EI experiment rather than this step's precursor (sibling record IMS8-EQ8.1c already used the reacting-ion convention). (was 100.0883, now 43.0173 = acetyl_cation.) Secondary fragmentation of the m/z-43 acetyl cation: inductive loss of CO gives the methyl cation CH3+ (m/z 15, 5%). Book draws 0 electron-pushing arcs: Eq. 8.2 is a thermochemical fragmentation map (log k printed above each reaction arrow, heats of formation printed below each species), not a curved-arrow figure. All electron moves here are curator-inferred from the mechanism-type label printed under the reaction arrow; none is drawn on the page. ONE double-barbed arrow: the C5-C7 sigma pair collapses entirely onto C5 (the carbon of the departing carbon monoxide, drawn here as the closed-shell [C-]#[O+] form), leaving C7 as the methyl cation. (A move depositing a lone pair on C5 is reported by the arrow checker as a soft 'lone pair rather than radicals' note.)

Cross-linked to IMS_8_2_ind_4_5. It cleaves the correct C1-C5 bond (my C7-C5), giving [C+]1 (my methyl cation) + a CO fragment, but writes the CO as '[C]5{=}[O]6' (a C=O double bond, divalent carbene carbon) rather than the C#O triple bond; this record uses the standard [C-]#[O+] CO. Bond-order under-specification only, cleavage is correct.
